title: ass-spec checkpoint review payload
description: Contract for the opaque payload the ass-spec plugin accepts in checkpoint_review, published to the Agent via the platform tool description. The payload shape is chosen by the checkpoint collectionId: for collectionId 'checklist-dimensions' submit checklist_review (itemIdField check_id); for collectionId 'candidate-findings' (itemIdField candidate_id) or 'document-navigation' (itemIdField unitId) submit decisions; for collectionId 'cross-document-relationships' (itemIdField relationship_id) submit cross_document_review.

oneOf.title: checklist-dimensions payload
oneOf.description: Use this shape when collectionId is 'checklist-dimensions'. Cover the declared CHK item IDs exactly once and in order.

oneOf.title: candidate-findings / document-navigation payload
oneOf.description: Use this shape when collectionId is 'candidate-findings' or 'document-navigation'. Each decision handles the declared item IDs (candidate_id or unitId) exactly once.

oneOf.title: cross-document-relationships payload
oneOf.description: Use this shape when collectionId is 'cross-document-relationships'. Each entry covers one relationship_id exactly once.

evidence_ref.description: A reference to one frozen source section. Copy the five fields verbatim from the matching sourceChunks entry; never invent or re-derive them, and never substitute the EvidenceRecord evidenceId (a different identifier namespace).

finding_refs.description: finding_id values of the confirmed findings that back a REWORK or ESCALATE row.

decision.description: One semantic review decision. CONFIRMED requires severity, object_id, dimension, gap, impact, recommendation, closure_evidence, and non-empty evidence; the other statuses require review_note (and MERGED requires merged_into pointing at an already-confirmed finding_id).

finding_id.description: A finding ID you assign, unique across the whole review and stable across checkpoint pages.

candidate_ids.description: The candidate_id values from candidateFindings this decision handles. Required for SUPPRESSED/MERGED/UNVERIFIED; CONFIRMED may omit it only for a reviewer-origin finding.

object_id.description: Required when status is CONFIRMED; identifies one business object.

dimension.description: Required when status is CONFIRMED; the CHK-xx dimension this finding maps to.

evidence.description: Required when status is CONFIRMED; verbatim lines from the target Spec that trace to the candidate.

review_note.description: Required when status is SUPPRESSED, MERGED, or UNVERIFIED.

merged_into.description: Only when status is MERGED; the finding_id of an already-confirmed finding.

cross_document_relationship.description: One cross-document relationship review. outcome FINDING or UNVERIFIED requires a non-empty decisions array.
